title: The tensor sheafification unit on a finite free neighborhood
statement: Let X be a scheme with its pro-etale site, alpha:R -> S a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, V a site object, and M a sheaf of R|V-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let q be finite local generators for M which are bases. Fix i in q.I and a:W -> V with a factorization t:(W,a) -> q.X(i) in the slice [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. The sheafification unit for the sectionwise scalar-extension presheaf S|V tensor_(R|V) M [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], evaluated at (W,a), is an isomorphism. No nonemptiness or positive-rank assumption is needed.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; An integral basis gives a rational continuous matrix

proof.text: On the chosen finite free neighborhood, use the inverse of the generator isomorphism and freeSectionsLinearEquiv to identify integral sections with the finite product of the coefficient ring. Tensor this equivalence, use TensorProduct.piRight and AlgebraTensorModule.rid, and transport back to the free target module sections. This constructs a sectionwise isomorphism with coordinate formula s tensor m maps to (s times alpha(m_j))_j.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; An integral basis gives a rational continuous matrix

proof.text: Naturality of the integral coordinates, of alpha, and of the target free projections proves compatibility with restriction on pure tensors. Tensor induction extends it to every section. Thus the restricted additive tensor presheaf is isomorphic to the underlying presheaf of the finite free target sheaf, and is a sheaf.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; An integral basis gives a rational continuous matrix

proof.text: The sheafification unit is locally injective and locally surjective. These properties survive restriction along Over.forget. Both its source and target restricted presheaves are now sheaves, hence the restricted unit is an isomorphism. Evaluate at the given factorization t and reflect the resulting additive-group isomorphism to the module category. All constructions allow empty bases, zero rings and empty objects.

theorem localFreeTensorUnit_isIso {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {R S : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (α : R ⟶ S)
    (V : X.ProEt)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose _
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (R.over V)))
    (q : M.LocalGeneratorsData) [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) (W : X.ProEt) (a : W ⟶ V) (t : Over.mk a ⟶ q.X i) :
    IsIso (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        (S.over V)).obj)).unit.app
      (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (latticeScalarMap α V) M)).app (op (Over.mk a)))
